entries.title: GitHub machines left idle for about an hour
entries.what: From about 10:50 PM to 11:55 PM (11-05) GitHub's busy jobs fell from 17 to 6 of 20: the B and T dispatcher sent the next sample only when 3 or fewer jobs were busy, and the loop check looked only at whether each loop was logging. The agent's half-hour checks printed the falling count and reported the machines on track.
entries.outcome: Caught by the author. The dispatcher now fills every free slot up to 18 with partial sends (bt3_parts.json, read by the relay, which now also handles the B-cell samples); machines_busy.py prints IDLE when GitHub has fewer than 16 of 18 or Google fewer than 8 of 8, in every check.
